comment: Reference hashes of the tape gate (tools/native/gate.ps1). md5 prefixes, as recorded in docs/agents/CPU_OPT*_RESULT.md for cpu/opt .. cpu/opt4 (77bed6e0). A reference changes only with a deliberate, documented behaviour change; never to make a gate pass.
state_note: State hashes are of state.json with savestate_version 34 (native/win, checkpoint version bump of 2026-11-17, the user's decision). The version-33 values were 5c27c8fa6c7d (Westopolis) and 039b7d06d130 (Final Haunt): the two reports are byte-identical once that one field is replaced (0 memory blocks differ), shown on native/win before the change. A build at checkpoint version 33 (cpu/opt4 and earlier) must be gated against the version-33 values. gate.ps1 does that by itself: it reads savestate_version from the run's state.json and takes the reference from state_md5_12_by_savestate_version; a version without an entry there fails the check (state_md5_12 is the newest version's value, kept for readers).
